questions.objective: Name the parts of a labelled pattern.
questions.question: Which term names the opening part of a labelled pattern?
questions.explanation: The head is the opening part of a labelled pattern by definition. See section 1.1

questions.objective: Read a plotted trend from a figure.
questions.question: The figure plots one series against its index. In which direction does the series move as the index grows?

options.D: It cannot be told from the figure

questions.explanation: The plotted line runs from lower left to upper right, so the series rises. See section 1.1

figure.alt: A rising line from left to right.

questions.objective: Choose the rule that fits a stated case.
questions.question: A rule applies only when both of its conditions hold. One condition holds and the other does not. What follows?
questions.explanation: Both conditions are required, so one alone leaves the rule idle. See section 1.1

questions.objective: Read a value out of a small table.
questions.question:
Use the table.
xy
12
questions.explanation: The single row pairs an x of 1 with a y of 2. See section 1.2

questions.objective: State what a labelled step does.
questions.question: What does a labelled step do to the value it is handed?

options.B: It replaces the value with its label
options.C: It records the value under its label

questions.explanation: A labelled step records what it is handed under its own label. See section 1.2

questions.objective: Order two steps whose results differ.
questions.question: Two steps are run in turn, and swapping their order changes the result. What can be said of the pair?

options.D: Both steps have the same effect

questions.explanation: A result that changes with the order is what it means for the order to matter. See section 1.2
